{"metadata":{"description":"A Command Code LLM provider plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — supporting all subscription plans (incl. Go & Pro) via Studio API / gateway.专为 DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 打造的 Command Code LLM 接入插件，全面支持包括 Go/Pro 在内的各类订阅方案。","id":"gh:1333943834","install_available":false,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-commandcode-provider","slug":"Victor-770/dsh-commandcode-provider","topics":["dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"A Command Code LLM provider plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — supporting all subscription plans (i"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"ncl. Go & Pro) via Studio API / gateway.专为 DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 打造的 Command Code LLM 接入插件，全面支持包括 G"},{"id":"p1s3","text":"ia Studio API / gateway.专为 DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 打造的 Command Code LLM 接入插件，全面支持包括 Go/Pro 在内的各类订阅方案。"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-commandcode-provider"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**Languages:** English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A custom LLM provider plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) that connects dsh to Command Code — a faithf"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"ul port of pi-commandcode-provider onto dsh's LLM seam."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"> **Works with every Command Code plan, including the $1/month Go plan.** Even the Go plan — the onl"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"y one without Provider API access — gives you an API key in the Studio; that key authenticates the C"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"LI/agent login. This plugin uses that same key against Command Code's own `/alpha/generate` endpoint"},{"id":"p5s4","text":", **not** the traditional Provider API protocol, so it works even when a plan has no Provider API ac"},{"id":"p5s5","text":"ot** the traditional Provider API protocol, so it works even when a plan has no Provider API access."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"> **Disclaimer:** This is an unofficial, community-maintained integration. It is not affiliated with"},{"id":"p6s2","text":", endorsed by, or supported by Command Code. You need your own Command Code account. Command Code's "},{"id":"p6s3","text":"terms, availability, and pricing apply."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"> **Requires dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 or newer.** This release targets the 0.2 LLM and settings seam; on an ol"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"der dsh the entry will not load. Settings edited on **Settings → Models → Command Code → Edit** appl"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"y live — no dsh restart."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Quick Start"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"**Newbie-friendly: one command to install — the plugin mounts itself, no config files to edit.**"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"### 1. Install"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"The package declares `dsh.bundle`, so `dsh plugin add` installs it AND automatically joins it to the"},{"id":"p12s2","text":" profile's bundle layers — the shipped `cordis.patch.yml` mounts the provider row for you."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"> Do **not** also add a manual `cordis.patch.yml` row for this plugin — the bundle patch already mou"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"nts it; a second row would double-register the provider."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"### 2. Restart dsh"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"The provider then appears in the web UI automatically."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"### 3. Get your API key"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Even on the **Go plan**, Command Code gives you an API key used for authentication:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"1. Open commandcode.ai and sign in.
2. Go to **Studio → API Keys** (in the sidebar).
3. Click **Gene"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"rate API key** and copy it."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"> This key is an *authentication* key for using Command Code — it is not a "Provider API" key. The p"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"lugin speaks Command Code's own `/alpha/generate` protocol with it, so **no Provider API access is r"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"equired**, and the Go plan works."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"### 4. Configure the API key (either way)"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"** Command:** In a dsh chat, run:"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"and paste the key when prompted."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"That's it — pick a Command Code model from the model picker and start chatting."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"This plugin is **not** a traditional API-protocol provider:"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"- It talks to Command Code's own streaming endpoint `https://api.commandcode.ai/alpha/generate` with"},{"id":"p27s2","text":" the same wire protocol the official CLI uses (`x-command-code-version`, `x-cli-environment`, `x-pro"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"ject-slug`, … headers).
- The API key from Studio is an **authentication** credential for that endpo"},{"id":"p27s4","text":"int — the same one `cmd login` writes to `~/.commandcode/auth.json`.
- Because it rides the CLI prot"},{"id":"p27s5","text":"ocol instead of the Provider API, it works on **every plan, including Go**, and even models the Prov"},{"id":"p27s6","text":"ider API cannot serve.
- Model discovery still uses the public Provider API catalog endpoint when re"},{"id":"p27s7","text":"achable, with an offline cache at `<dsh home>/commandcode/commandcode-models.json`; if that endpoint"},{"id":"p27s8","text":" is unreachable (e.g. a Go plan), the last cached catalog keeps serving."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## Functionality"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"Everything the pi plugin does, on the dsh host plane:"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"- **Provider registration** — registers the `commandcode` provider route on `ctx.llm` with the same "},{"id":"p30s2","text":"`/alpha/generate` streaming protocol, retry/timeout/abort semantics, and message/tool conversion as "},{"id":"p30s3","text":"the pi plugin (paired tool-call filtering, data-URL image forwarding, legacy schema normalization).
"},{"id":"p30s4","text":"- **Model discovery with offline cache** — fetches the catalog from `https://api.commandcode.ai/prov"},{"id":"p30s5","text":"ider/v1/models` and caches it locally (versioned, atomic writes); offline, the last cached catalog k"},{"id":"p30s6","text":"eeps serving.
- **Reasoning metadata** — models with known Command Code effort support advertise the"},{"id":"p30s7","text":"ir thinking levels through the LLM seam; a selected level is sent as `params.reasoning_effort`.
- **"},{"id":"p30s8","text":"Image input** — models marked `image` in the catalog accept image blocks (resolved through dsh's dur"},{"id":"p30s9","text":"able attachment service); text-only models reject images before any network request.
- **Authenticat"},{"id":"p30s10","text":"ion** — credentials resolve per request through, in order:
1. the Harness credential seam (`ctx.cred"},{"id":"p30s11","text":"entials`, what the web Models page writes),
2. the trusted launch environment (`COMMANDCODE_API_KEY`"},{"id":"p30s12","text":"),
3. existing Command Code auth files: `~/.commandcode/auth.json`, `~/.pi/agent/auth.json`, `~/.omp"},{"id":"p30s13","text":"mand Code auth files: `~/.commandcode/auth.json`, `~/.pi/agent/auth.json`, `~/.omp/agent/auth.json`."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"No browser OAuth flow — the key is entered in the web UI (**Settings → Models → Command Code → Edit*"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"*) or via `/commandcode-setkey`.
- **Commands** — `/commandcode-refresh` (re-fetch + re-register the"},{"id":"p31s3","text":" catalog), `/commandcode-status` (redacted diagnostics), `/commandcode-setkey` (store an API key).
-"},{"id":"p31s4","text":" **Pricing display** — the static per-model cost table from the pi plugin (USD per million tokens).
"},{"id":"p31s5","text":"- **Error hygiene** — context-overflow wording is normalized to `CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED`, and every"},{"id":"p31s6","text":" error/diagnostic text is redacted."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"The `commandcode-provider` settings section accepts (all optional):"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"| Field | Default | Meaning |"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"| `apiKeyEnv` | `COMMANDCODE_API_KEY` | Credential reference resolved per request |
| `displayName` "},{"id":"p35s2","text":"| `Command Code` | Name shown by selectors |
| `baseURL` | `COMMANDCODE_API_BASE` env → `https://api"},{"id":"p35s3","text":".commandcode.ai` | API base for `/alpha/generate` (usually leave at default) |
| `modelsUrl` | `COMM"},{"id":"p35s4","text":"ANDCODE_MODELS_URL` env → Provider API | Model discovery endpoint |
| `modelsTimeoutMs` | `COMMANDCO"},{"id":"p35s5","text":"DE_MODELS_TIMEOUT_MS` env → `10000` | Discovery timeout |
